Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

So, a Latino teenager and an Asian teenager go to school together. Their parents are servers and lawyers, respectively. Each kid got a B in math this semester. The servers' kid, the Latino one, knew his parents would be angry he made a B rather than an A, but the lawyers' kid, the Asian one, was relieved his grade had gone up. Which teenager was upset about getting a lower grade?
A. The Latino teenager with server parents
B. The Asian teenager with lawyer parents
C. Not answerable
